title: Longest Uncommon Subsequence II
goal: Solve Longest Uncommon Subsequence II: Find the longest uncommon subsequence among an array of strings.
strategy: Find the longest uncommon subsequence among an array of strings.

checks.condition: all(s not in t for j, t in enumerate(strs) if i != j)

inputRules: strs must be a non-empty array, e.g. ["aba","cdc","eae"]
